dialogues.speaker: Pashkov
dialogues.text: Pashkov, what does a newcomer like you know? Prime Ice is sturdy stuff. When we move it, we just push it along and let it slide. That's how everyone's done it for years!

dialogues.speaker: Vorontsov
dialogues.text: I understand, but no means no. According to the rules, unsafe operations mean a three-day suspension. You can only return to the worksite after you've memorized the safety code again.

dialogues.speaker: Pashkov
dialogues.text: Are you out of your mind? Do you have any idea what kind of situation we're in? The deadline's right around the corner! This is Svetloledovka, not that fancy opera house of yours! If work slows down, everyone's going to catch hell for it!

dialogues.speaker: Pashkov
dialogues.text: If we can't deliver the shipment and the higher-ups come looking into it, it won't just be me. The whole town will be packing up and getting out! You think you can shoulder that blame?

dialogues.speaker: Vorontsov
dialogues.text: No. But rules are rules. So you're not setting foot on-site today, Vorontsov.

dialogues.speaker: Pashkov
dialogues.text: You! Ugh... How did I end up dealing with a Prime Ice blockhead like you?
